results.name: fdps_build_scene_layer_draw_order
results.problems:
無阻礙。三點記錄：

1. Plate fix 的計數與實際不符，但意圖明確，照「body text and the Pool line both」全部替換。review.json 寫「four occurrences of DAT_00069cdc and three of DAT_00069cfe」，實際 plate 裡 DAT_00069cdc 出現 5 次（Algorithm 段 4 次 + Pool 行 1 次），DAT_00069cfe 出現 4 次（Algorithm 段 2 次 + Pool 行 1 次 + Rebuild note 1 次）。我把兩個符號的全部出現處都換成 data_fdps_scene_layer_count / data_fdps_scene_layer_draw_depth，沒有改動任何其他字句。沒有調整決定去遷就計數，只是把「全部」照字面執行。

2. 沒有 stray。git status --porcelain 在動手前只有 src/gamedata.h、src/mapdraw.c、src/mapdraw.h、tests/mapdraw.c、tools/code_emit/data/emit_state.json，全部落在允許的路徑內，所以沒有需要單獨先 commit 的檔案。ghidra_snapshot/comments.txt 是我重新匯出後才出現的變更（只有 plate comment 那一處，8 行增減）。

3. emit_issues.json 兩份 verdict 的 open_issues 都是空陣列，appended 0 筆。檔案原本就存在（215,868 bytes），我用 UTF-8 讀出再寫回，git diff 對該檔為空 — 也就是逐 byte 相同，編碼往返無損，等於通過了 mojibake 檢查。

emit_state.json 的 0002c220 entry 已為 {name, target, body_size "0x107", status "committed", rounds 0, emitted_against "0x107"}，欄位順序比照相鄰已 committed 的 entry，in_flight_since 已移除，未動其他 entry。

results.name: fdps_unit_select_status_icon
results.problems: No strays: git status before staging showed only src/unit.c, src/unit.h, tests/unit.c and tools/code_emit/data/emit_state.json, all inside the pipeline's own paths, so no separate stray commit was needed. Ghidra: both verdict files carried the same single fix (kind "plate", 0002ccd0) — the emit file said four occurrences of FUN_0002cda0, the review file said three; the plate in fact contained three (unit_index description, cycle description, Returns section) and all three were replaced with fdps_draw_map_unit, which is the whole of what both entries asked for, so it is counted as one applied fix. No rename or prototype fix was requested. Baseline audit Gate: orphan code ranges 0, error bookmarks 0, undefined bytes in .object1 0; program saved; snapshot re-exported (diff limited to 3 changed lines in ghidra_snapshot/comments.txt). Both verdict files had empty open_issues, so nothing was appended to emit_issues.json; the file was read and rewritten byte-identically, confirming the UTF-8 round trip left it unchanged (git reports it unmodified). emit_state.json entry 0002ccd0 now status committed, emitted_against 0xce, rounds 0, in_flight_since dropped; no other entry or field touched.

results.problems:
No strays: git status --porcelain before staging listed only src/unit.c, src/unit.h, tests/unit.c and tools/code_emit/data/emit_state.json, all inside the pipeline's own paths, so no separate stray commit was made and none was needed.

Ghidra: both verdict files carry the same single fix (kind "plate" at 0002d210) and no rename or prototype fix, so exactly one set_plate_comment was applied — FUN_00022be0 -> fdps_build_map_unit_array, FUN_0002df90 -> fdps_relocate_unit_array, "16 static callers / 228 references" replaced with "at least 100 distinct static callers -- a get_function_callers query returns a full page and is still at its own limit of 100", and a new "Lifetime:" line recording that the returned pointer does not survive fdps_relocate_unit_array. set_plate_comment returned success with three advisory warnings ("missing Algorithm / Parameters / Returns section") — those are the MCP server's generic template nags, not a failure, and the plate follows this project's own Pool/Evidence/Name/Boundary/Signature template, so nothing was changed to satisfy them. Baseline audit Gate: orphan code ranges 0, error bookmarks 0, undefined bytes in .object1 0. Program saved, snapshot re-exported; the staged ghidra_snapshot diff is confined to the 0002d210 plate block in comments.txt.

emit_issues.json: both verdict files have open_issues: [], so there was nothing to append and the file (30 existing keys) was left untouched — no 0002d210 key was created. issues_logged 0.

emit_state.json: the 0002d210 entry went in_flight -> committed, emitted_against "0x25", in_flight_since dropped, rounds kept at 0 verbatim. The file is nested under a "functions" object rather than keyed at top level, so the edit was made inside that; the diff is that one entry and nothing else.

target_lines is from wc -l (126). PowerShell's Measure-Object -Line reports 109 for the same file because it skips blank lines — the wc figure is the one reported.

results.name: fdps_move_path_trace
results.problems:
No strays: git status --porcelain before staging showed only src/movegrid.c, src/movegrid.h, tests/movegrid.c, tools/code_emit/data/emit_state.json and the two ghidra_snapshot files, so no separate stray commit was needed.

Ghidra fixes: all four applied (1 plate from emit, 2 plate + 1 prototype from review). The two plate fixes were folded into one set_plate_comment call because they touch the same comment; the review's second plate fix is explicitly a seconding of the emitter's Rebuild note, so the appended paragraph is the emitter's wording verbatim. Prototype set to `int fdps_move_path_trace(int goal_x, int goal_y, uchar *out_path, int start_x, int start_y, uchar mode)` with __cdecl kept.

Two transcription notes, neither a change of decision:
1. The mode-2 reword was inserted literally, but the replacement text ends mid-sentence where the original continued "and whose record byte +0x05 bit 0 is clear". I closed the inserted clause with a trailing " -- " so the original tail still attaches to "keeps only units whose ...", rather than reading as part of the side-byte clause. Punctuation only; no word of either text changed.
2. The plate's own "Signature:" line still reads `int mode`. No fix asked for it to change and I did not touch it, so the plate line and the database prototype now disagree on that one parameter. Flagging it rather than deciding it.

emit_issues.json: both verdict files have "open_issues": [], so nothing was appended and the file was left byte-identical (it already exists with 30 keys). issues_logged = 0.

Baseline audit Gate: orphan code ranges 0, error bookmarks 0, undefined bytes in .object1 0. Program saved and snapshot re-exported (comments.txt and functions.txt both moved, and are in the commit).

Commit message was written to a UTF-8 file and applied with git commit -F --cleanup=verbatim; the stored commit object was checked for the ASCII portions and for mojibake markers without printing the Traditional Chinese back through the console.
